name: kanagawa-kgrust
description: Kanagawa language support, backed by the kgrust language server.

semanticTokenScopes.$comment: `punctuation` is not in the standard LSP legend; the server defines it so it can say the `<` in `Foo<T>` is a bracket and the `<` in `a < b` is not. Themes without semantic colouring need it mapped back to a TextMate scope.

kanagawa.server.path.markdownDescription: Executable to launch. The default is the `kg` multi-tool on `PATH`; set it to a `kg-lsp` binary (and clear `#kanagawa.server.args#`) to run the server directly.

kanagawa.server.args.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `#kanagawa.server.path#`. `kg` needs the `lsp` subcommand; a bare `kg-lsp` binary needs none.

kanagawa.server.extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the server process.
